meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在macOS菜单栏添加一个闪电图标，用绿点/红点表示NanoClaw正在运行或已停止。点击图标可启动、停止或重启服务，并可直接打开日志。此功能仅适用于macOS。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: 会添加带绿/红点的闪电图标并显示运行状态。

say.text: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 的运行状态，带开始和停止按钮。
say.note: 点击图标即可控制服务。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 装一个菜单栏指示器，用来随时查看是否在运行。

howto.what_en: Adds a bolt icon to the macOS menu bar. A green dot means NanoClaw is running; red means stopped. Clicking the icon lets you start, stop, or restart the service and open its logs. macOS only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Adds a bolt icon with green/red dot showing status.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running status in the menu bar with Start/Stop controls.
Add a menu bar indicator for NanoClaw to check if it's running anytime.
